name: Apple TV 4K 3rd Gen (US)

radios.note: Thread is on the Wi-Fi + Ethernet (128 GB) model only; the Wi-Fi (64 GB) model has no Thread or Ethernet.

matter.note: Apple says Apple TV 4K can act as the home hub for Matter accessories, but no CSA listing for this device was checked, so certification is not confirmed.

apple_home.note: Becomes a home hub when added to a room in the Home app, for HomeKit and Matter accessories and remote access. Thread accessories need the Wi-Fi + Ethernet model.

google_home.note: No official source shows Apple TV hosting devices for Google Home.

alexa.note: No official source shows Apple TV hosting devices for Alexa.

smartthings.note: No official source shows Apple TV hosting devices for SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: No official source shows devices paired to the Apple TV appearing in Home Assistant.

hubRequired.note: The Apple TV itself is the home hub.

localControl.note: Apple's pages don't say which automations run locally.

hubType.note: A streaming box that Apple calls a smart home hub. The schema has no set-top-box type; 'speaker-display' (a device whose main job is media, with a hub built in, like HomePod) fits better than 'hub' (a dedicated bridge).

deviceProtocols.note: Thread (Wi-Fi + Ethernet model) for HomeKit and Matter Thread accessories.

matterBridge.note: Apple doesn't describe the Apple TV as a Matter bridge.

threadBorderRouter.note: Wi-Fi + Ethernet model only; Apple names Apple TV 4K as a Thread-enabled home hub.

maxDevices.note: No limit found in the sources.

summary: A streaming box that doubles as the Apple Home hub, the Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) handles HomeKit and Matter accessories and remote access once you add it to a room in the Home app. Only the Wi-Fi + Ethernet model has Thread and works as a Thread border router. Apple's pages don't tie it to Google Home, Alexa or SmartThings.
caveats: Only the Wi-Fi + Ethernet (128 GB) model has Thread; the Wi-Fi (64 GB) model cannot serve as a Thread border router.
No CSA Matter certificate for the Apple TV itself was checked; its Matter role rests on Apple's support pages.
